KYC.TIER.definition: Tiered customer due diligence or wallet KYC: simplified, standard, or enhanced checks differentiated by wallet limit, customer risk, or use case.
KYC.TIER.code_when: The claim explicitly links different KYC/due-diligence levels to wallet type, value/holding limit, or customer risk.
KYC.TIER.dont_code_when: Internal staff authorisation, platform access-control tiers, transaction limits without KYC, or one-level identity verification.

KYC.INTERMED.definition: Allocation of customer KYC/AML responsibility between the central bank and authorised intermediaries such as banks or PSPs.
KYC.INTERMED.code_when: The claim states who performs customer identification, due diligence, or AML/CFT checks in the CBDC operating/distribution model.
KYC.INTERMED.dont_code_when: Banks are mentioned without a KYC/AML responsibility, or the claim concerns generic distribution only.

PROC.pilot_learning.definition: Executed-pilot operational or methodological finding that has no more specific substantive design code; audit-only and excluded from centre measures.
PROC.pilot_learning.code_when: An own-project pilot/test produced a concrete empirical process result and no specific substantive family describes the result better.
PROC.pilot_learning.dont_code_when: Plans, agendas, workgroup purposes, future research, or an executed result that fits TECH, OPS, ADOPT, PRIV, AML, INTEROP, or another substantive family.

LEGAL.basis.definition: CBDC-specific legal authority to issue, legal-tender status, or required CBDC legislation; audit-only and excluded from centre measures.
LEGAL.basis.code_when: The claim concerns the issuer's authority to issue CBDC, CBDC legal-tender status, or legislation specifically required for the focal CBDC.
LEGAL.basis.dont_code_when: General financial-market, consumer, data-protection, or infrastructure regulation without a CBDC-specific legal-basis claim.

INST.mandate.definition: Concrete institutional governance or operating responsibility in the focal CBDC system; audit-only and excluded from centre measures.
INST.mandate.code_when: The claim allocates a CBDC governance, issuance, operation, oversight, or accountability role to a named institution.
INST.mandate.dont_code_when: Stakeholder lists, generic central-bank mandates, or mentions of institutions without a concrete focal-CBDC role.

OTHER.keep.definition: Complete own-project design claim outside all specific families; audit-only and excluded from centre measures.
OTHER.keep.code_when: The statement passes the scope rule but no substantive, system, process, legal, or institutional code fits.
OTHER.keep.dont_code_when: Use as a fallback for generic context, uncertainty, fragments, or a claim that fits a named family.

INTEROP.domestic.definition: Domestic CBDC integration, convertibility, acceptance, funding/defunding, or settlement with national payment rails, banks, PSPs, wallets, cards, or commercial-bank money.
INTEROP.domestic.code_when: The focal claim is domestic technical/payment integration or par convertibility, including card-wallet or co-badging integration without a foreign element.
INTEROP.domestic.dont_code_when: Pure usability/adoption without integration, or an explicit foreign jurisdiction, corridor, remittance, FX, or cross-currency flow.

INTEROP.crossborder.definition: CBDC interoperability for explicit cross-border or cross-currency flows: foreign jurisdictions/CBDCs, corridors, remittances, PvP, or FX.
INTEROP.crossborder.code_when: The claim explicitly concerns a foreign jurisdiction/CBDC, international corridor, remittance, cross-border payment, FX, or cross-currency settlement.
INTEROP.crossborder.dont_code_when: Visa/Mastercard, card wallets, co-badging, or domestic rails without an explicit foreign/cross-border element.

CASH.relation.definition: Relationship between the focal CBDC and physical cash: complement/substitute, coexistence, conversion, cash-like role, or legal-tender relation.
CASH.relation.code_when: The issuer states how CBDC relates to, converts to/from, complements, replaces, or shares legal status with cash.
CASH.relation.dont_code_when: General digital-payment adoption or an isolated cash word without a CBDC-cash relationship.

STAB.disintermediation.definition: Financial-stability and monetary-transmission effects through deposits, bank funding/balance sheets, lending, bank runs, or central-bank financing.
STAB.disintermediation.code_when: The focal CBDC claim concerns deposit migration, bank funding/profitability, credit supply, bank runs, or related transmission effects.
STAB.disintermediation.dont_code_when: Generic macroeconomic context without a focal CBDC mechanism.

OPS.resilience.definition: CBDC operational resilience: cyber security, continuity, availability, incident response, fraud resistance, recovery, or critical dependency risk.
OPS.resilience.code_when: The issuer states a concrete focal-CBDC resilience feature, requirement, risk, or executed-test result.
OPS.resilience.dont_code_when: Generic technology risk, future security research, or offline privacy/reach without an operational-resilience claim.

ADOPT.experience.definition: CBDC adoption and user/merchant experience: convenience, accessibility of interaction, acceptance, fees, incentives, readiness, trust, or practical use cases.
ADOPT.experience.code_when: The main claim concerns willingness or barriers to use, usability, merchant acceptance, incentives, costs, or user experience.
ADOPT.experience.dont_code_when: Technical integration itself, universal reach/access itself, or generic payment-system efficiency without an adoption mechanism.

SYS.design.definition: Core focal-CBDC architecture and operating model not captured by a more specific family: issuance/distribution structure, operator roles, system components, or wallet parameters.
SYS.design.code_when: A complete own-project architecture or operating-model claim is substantive but no more specific code applies.
SYS.design.dont_code_when: Use instead of TECH, KYC, INTEROP, PRIV, AML, PROG, or another specific family; stakeholder lists or generic project descriptions.
